scene: Atop the ladder, you reach an ornate catwalk overlooking vast rows.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a high wooden catwalk lined by giant bookshelves. On the far left, a brass telescope sits on a tripod. Near left stands the player in teal jacket and sneakers, freshly arrived from the ladder. In the centre, a blue book glows on a wooden lectern. On the right, a rope bridge hangs.
shown: a swiveling brass telescope mounted on a tripod at far left
a pulsating blue book perched on an open reading lectern in the centre
a narrow wooden rope bridge stretching into another stack aisle on the right
